abstracts.abstract: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT 172 OF 1995, RELATING TO THE KERSHAW COUNTY TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE, SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT EACH MEMBER OF THE KERSHAW COUNTY TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE SHALL RECEIVE NINETY DOLLARS FOR EACH MEETING AT WHICH HE IS IN ATTENDANCE AND THAT THE CHAIRMAN SHALL RECEIVE ONE HUNDRED SEVENTY-FIVE DOLLARS, AND TO PROVIDE THAT SUCH PAYMENTS SHALL NOT OCCUR MORE THAN EIGHTEEN TIMES EACH FISCAL YEAR. - RATIFIED TITLE

posted_text:
🚗 Transportation
SC S 586 — Kershaw County Committee Members Get Paid $90 Per Meeting

This bill changes how members of the Kershaw County Transportation Committee are paid. Each committee member will now receive $90 for every meeting they attend, and the chairman will get $175 per meeting. These payments can't happen more than 15-18 times a year, based on the county's 'C' fund revenues. ...
